description: A mod for the game Stardew Valley that adds new data assets, map/tile properties, and features for other mods to use.

releases.name: EMP v1.7.2
releases.body:
**Bug Fixes:**
* Fixes the Fish Locations asset, which was ignoring the "TileAreas" setting when used with newer SMAPI/CP versions
  * Reported by zVirro

Designed for Stardew Valley v1.6.15.

releases.name: EMP v1.7.1
releases.body:
**Bug Fixes:**
* Fixes compatibility with Android SMAPI by avoiding outdated code
  * Reported by JevilTheDevil09

Designed for Stardew Valley v1.6.15.

releases.name: EMP v1.7.0
releases.body:
**Changes:**
* Adds new console commands: "EMP ListGSQs", "EMP ListMailFlags"
* Adds i18n support for all console command text
* Improves performance for Content Patcher tokens
  * Thanks to SinZ and atravita for code suggestions, and anyone who helped them with logs/feedback.

Designed for Stardew Valley v1.6.15.

releases.name: EMP v1.6.1
releases.body:
**Changes:**
* Adds Portuguese translation by Mur16

Designed for Stardew Valley v1.6.15.

releases.name: EMP v1.6.0
releases.body:
**Changes:**
* Adds game state query: Is Time Passing

**Bug Fixes:**
* The Player Stat token is no longer case-sensitive, and has mildly improved performance
  * Reported by chu√e and Button

Designed for Stardew Valley v1.6.15.
